subject: SOC 2 Type II — initial artifact asks, audit-period clarification & bridge letter draft
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Jane Doe <security@tidebank.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II — initial artifact asks, audit-period clarification & bridge letter draft

Hi Jane,

Thanks for taking this — excited to get TideBank onboarded. We're kicking off the request for Redwood's SOC 2 Type II materials so your security team can complete the SIG/CAIQ and close the procurement checklist. A few quick asks and notes to keep this low-friction: 

What we need (minimal / first-pass):
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) and test controls matrix (if available)
- Management representation letter (signed)
- Audit period dates clearly listed in the report
- Bridge letter (if most recent Type II period doesn't overlap your desired window) — we can provide a short template
- Control descriptions / system boundaries (short doc or spreadsheet)
- Evidence samples: access control policy snapshot, change management ticket sample, admin user list export (redacted PII), encryption key management summary, recent vulnerability scan or pen-test exec summary
- Log retention policy and a 7-day sample of system audit logs (we accept redacted slices; see transfer options below)

Transfer options: secure SFTP (preferred), encrypted OneDrive/SharePoint link, or our secure intake portal (Drive link below). If you prefer SFTP, reply and we'll provide host/creds + a pre-created target folder.

Audit period question: can you confirm the audit period covered by your latest Type II (start/end dates)? If your available report falls outside the window the procurement team expects, a short bridge letter is sufficient to attestate continuity for the missing dates.

Timeline: if possible, could you share the core artifacts above by EOD Thu 5 May? That gives our reviewers time to run a quick control crosswalk and flag any follow-ups. If that timeline is tight, tell us a reasonable ETA and we'll adjust.

Attachments: I attached a minimal artifact shortlist CSV and a bridge-letter draft for your reviewer to adapt.

If helpful, below is a suggested one-line reply that your security coordinator can send back to confirm next steps: 

"We can provide the Type II report and the requested artifacts via SFTP; we'll confirm host/creds by 5/3 and aim to upload by 5/6."

Quick ask for clarity: are redacted logs acceptable for the initial review (we can follow up for more detail if necessary)?

Thanks — Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Senior Security Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: redwood_typeii_artifact_shortlist.csv (text/csv), redwood_bridge_letter_template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document), sftp_instructions.txt (text/plain)

From: Jane Doe <security@tidebank.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 14:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II — initial artifact asks, audit-period clarification & bridge letter draft

Hi Jordan,

Thanks — we can take this on. Quick answers:
- We have a Type II report for the period 2025-10-01 — 2026-09-30.
- We can provide the PDF, test matrix, and management rep letter.
- For logs: we can provide redacted slices for the initial review; full unredacted logs require a narrow NDA addendum and justification.

Clarifying question on the audit window: our most recent report ends 2026-09-30. Is that acceptable, or do you need coverage through 2027? If you need newer coverage, we will need to provide a bridge letter that explicitly states controls continued unchanged since the report end date.

Transfer: SFTP works for us. Please send host/credentials when ready.

Target: we can get the PDF + matrix + management letter to you by Tue 4 May and the log slices by Fri 7 May, assuming no further redaction back-and-forth.

Thanks,
Jane

Jane — thanks, that's helpful.

On Wed, Apr 28, 2027 at 2:42 PM Jane Doe <security@tidebank.com> wrote:
> Thanks — we can take this on. Quick answers:
> - We have a Type II report for the period 2025-10-01 — 2026-09-30.
> - We can provide the PDF, test matrix, and management rep letter.
> - For logs: we can provide redacted slices for the initial review; full unredacted logs require a narrow NDA addendum and justification.

That's fine — redacted slices are acceptable for our initial evidence review. Two quick notes and next steps: 

1) Audit period / bridge letter: your period (ending 2026-09-30) is acceptable for us to proceed with the security intake. To be clear for procurement: if the evaluation requires coverage through 2027 we will ask for a short bridge letter. We attached a concise bridge-letter template that typically suffices — one paragraph signed by an executive that confirms controls remained materially consistent and lists any exceptions.

2) Evidence checklist: we'll take the PDF + test matrix + management rep letter first; please include control descriptions/system boundary if available. If you can also include a short change management sample ticket and an admin user export (redacted usernames ok), that'll let us close ~60% of the SIG questions quickly.

3) Transfer: please send SFTP host/creds to sftp_admin@redwood.com and place files in /incoming/TIDE-DB-4739. We rotated the intake folder so uploads map directly to the HubSpot deal. If SFTP is problematic, paste a secure Share link to the Drive path in your reply and we'll download.

4) Timeline: Tue 4 May for the core report files works; logs by Fri 7 May is fine. If you need a slightly later cutoff, tell us.

I'll loop in our procurement reviewer (karthik and kimberly cc'd) to monitor. Thank you for the quick turnaround — this keeps the contract review on schedule.

Best,
Jordan

--
